subject: I am keeping a kean eye on
author: Paul-Ferrie
body:
I am keeping a kean eye on Forza 3, NFS Shift, Blur, Split/Second and of course very close eye on seeing what CG next releasing. Hopefully this will be something along the lines of a skinned fresh looking BP.  I certainly wouldn't complain if it turns out to be the case.

I am not sure what kiond of driver i am. I like the realisme of the likes of Forza but also like the thrill with BP

I think Most Wanted was the last half decent NFS title that i played. Everyone knows that the NFS title has fallening well short of the mark wirth previuos titles. I hope Shift is not a let down and the same for what every CG release.

//-- Life of a Glasgow Flash Developer
